title: Close fleet-ops#480 now that the canary reports the ledger source covered
body:
## Goal

Close fleet-ops#480 now that the canary reports the ledger source covered. #583 already shipped `bin/fleet-escalation-completion` and flipped `led-escalation-matrix-fixes` to `enforced`. This PR keeps that from silently rotting.

Closes #480.

## Verification
